headline: Bursa Malaysia Opens Lower as FBM KLCI Drops Below 1,560 Level
summary: Bursa Malaysia opened lower on Friday as global equity selling and tech valuation concerns pulled the benchmark FBM KLCI below 1,560.
why: The FBM KLCI is the benchmark stock index for publicly traded companies in Malaysia.

impacts.name: FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI
impacts.why: Global risk aversion and tech sector weakness pushed the Malaysian equity benchmark lower.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Global risk-off sentiment and semiconductor sector concerns pulled the Malaysian benchmark index below 1,560 points.
